run_qps_scenario_check: run the sanity check script to verify qps benchmark scenarios have not changed
run_scenario_generators: run the json_run_localhost_scenario_gen and qps_json_driver_scenario_gen scripts in the qps test directory
run_buildifier_format: run buildifier to format all build files recursively in the qps test directory
check_git_status_for_changes: check git status to detect if qps_json_driver_scenarios.bzl or json_run_localhost_scenarios.bzl were modified
review_sanity_check_script: review the check_qps_scenario_changes script that validates qps benchmark scenario files are up to date
